Name: wrong-targetport
Diagnosis: Primary issue: target pods are reachable directly, but the Service targetPort does not match declared container ports. Fix the Service targetPort or the pod containerPort/listener.

Name: selector-mismatch
Diagnosis: No pods matched the selector. The service selector/deployment labels may be wrong, or the workload has not created pods.

Name: crashloop-workload
Diagnosis: Deployment replicas are not available. Fix scheduling, image pulls, crashes, or probes before chasing service networking. | Primary issue: container is crashing. Check logs, config, secrets, probes, and startup command before networking. | The service has no ready endpoints because selected pods are not Ready. Fix workload health first.

Name: bad-image-pull
Diagnosis: Deployment replicas are not available. Fix scheduling, image pulls, crashes, or probes before chasing service networking. | Primary issue: image pull failure detected. Fix image name, registry auth, or image policy before networking. | The service has no ready endpoints because selected pods are not Ready. Fix workload health first.

Name: ingress-misconfig
Diagnosis: Ingress 'bad-ingress' points at service 'ingress-target' but backend port '9999' does not match the service ports. | Ingress 'bad-ingress' references missing/unreadable TLS secret 'missing-web-tls'. | Ingress references class 'no-such-class', but that IngressClass was not found/readable.

Name: native-networkpolicy-block
Diagnosis: Likely issue: target ingress NetworkPolicy may block traffic from 'knm-test-source/source-open-84f989b5dd-h8rj6' to service 'knm-test-target/native-block'. Policies: allow-other-source-only. | Direct pod IP connectivity failed from source pod 'source-open-84f989b5dd-h8rj6' to target pod 'native-block-5f88775fc6-s6z92' on port 8080. Check CNI/overlay routing, NetworkPolicy, sidecars, and whether the app listens on that port. | Source-to-target service connection failed while the target has ready endpoints. Check source egress policy, target ingress policy, service port, and app listener.
